author: Roger
name: GuessCandy
short: October chat candy hunt with real photos and persistent points.
description: Activity-triggered candy photos, first-correct-answer catches, rare bigger candies, yearly collections, custom collection milestones and leaderboards. Uses its own points, not Red bank currency.
install_msg: Load guesscandy, then use [p]candyset channel #general and [p]candyset enabled true. See README.md for setup and rewards.
end_user_data_statement: Stores Discord user IDs with yearly per-server candy counts, points and earned milestones. Does not store chat contents. Supports Red data deletion requests.
